meta.title: Request resume
meta.description: Resumes an interrupted turn in the same turn: when a model request fails with a timeout, rate limit, server, or transport error and the provider's own retry budget is spent, the plugin waits, then re-sends the request so the turn finishes instead of ending with "This turn failed". Cancelling the turn ends the wait, and per-step and per-turn budgets stop a turn that keeps failing.
